brief_rationale: The trajectory has no responsibility-chain error: the doctor immediately rejected home observation, recognized high-risk odontogenic facial/eye involvement after ineffective levofloxacin, directed urgent ED/oral-maxillofacial care, repeatedly screened airway/eye/systemic red flags, and closed with concrete discharge medication, wound, follow-up, and emergency thresholds. High-order performance was completed in multiple areas, especially correcting false reassurance from low fever/normal oxygenation, dynamic escalation from taxi/ED to 120 or in-hospital call bell, and addressing fear/misunderstanding around incision drainage and anesthesia without overpromising. Despite a couple of truncated/ellipsis turns, the doctor later repaired them and the overall bounded episode closure was safe, executable, and confirmed by the family.

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode transitioned safely from home failure to ED, inpatient source control, postoperative monitoring, and discharge with medication, wound-care, follow-up, dental-source, and emergency-return instructions. The last family message confirms receipt and execution; residual uncertainty about the exact antibiotic name is mitigated by the pharmacy-circled written schedule.
